question: Should this draft continue as the core mutating Claws plugin-artifact installer, and what atomicity/provenance contract must it satisfy before merge?
rationale: The concrete bugs are fixable, but the PR crosses new Claws product direction, plugin install security boundaries, and persisted ownership semantics that automation cannot set as policy.

options.title: Require Atomic Provenance First
options.body: Keep this PR open and require Claw-created/direct ownership classification plus rollback or preflight ordering before plugin artifact mutation can merge.

options.title: Keep As Draft Behind The Stack
options.body: Leave the PR open but do not merge it until the RFC and prerequisite Claws PRs settle the workspace and artifact lifecycle contract.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want plugin artifact installation to move to a later Claws implementation pass.

recommendation.title: Require Atomic Provenance First
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require Claw-created/direct ownership classification plus rollback or preflight ordering before plugin artifact mutation can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision combines product direction with plugin lifecycle persistence and executable artifact boundaries, and steipete is the clearest routing owner from repository policy and history.
